perche: ENTRY Z-C21.3 (the probe verdicts), finding N25. The guide (IFeatureManager~InsertStructuralWeldment5.html, Remarks) gives the EMPTY string as the configuration name for a SOLIDWORKS-supplied weldment profile, and up to library 0.141.0 the library refused an empty size outright. The Z-C21.3 probe of the member group (28/9/2026) measured that the empty string works, but not the way the guide suggests: the SOLIDWORKS 2021 profile iso\square tube.sldlfp has four sizes, and with an empty name SOLIDWORKS built the 20 x 20 section without an error (N7), where the same file with «80 x 80 x 5» built the 80 x 80 (N8). So the library now accepts an empty size only on a file with ONE size, where there is nothing to choose, and on a file with several sizes refuses it naming them, so that the next call can copy one.
il_difetto_che_questo_caso_prende: Step 2 asks for the probe's supplied profile with an empty size: it must be refused, and the refusal must list the sizes of the file. On library 0.141.0 it is refused with a message that names none of them (red on the first expected piece). Step 1 is its twin: the same profile, the same L, the size written as the file spells it.
i_numeri: Measured by the probe on the L (0,0,0)-(500,0,0)-(500,0,400), one group, miter: iso\square tube.sldlfp «80 x 80 x 5» volume 1292065.78 mm3, two bodies, bar A to X 540 and bar B to Z -40 (N8); the same file with an empty size volume 120330.17 mm3, a 20 x 20 section (N7). GetConfigurationNames of the file: 20 x 20 x 2, 30 x 30 x 2.6, 40 x 40 x 4, 80 x 80 x 5. The file is the Italian installation's, where the probe found it (GetExecutablePath\lang\<language>\weldment profiles).

attese.perche_questa_tolleranza: the probe's volume for this file, size and L (N8); the 20 x 20 that the empty name builds is 120330.17, and half a mm3 covers the rounding of the answer
